summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Multimodal

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Make-A-Scene in the Multimodal area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Make-A-Scene: Scene-Based Text-to-Image Generation with Human Priors”. The page names Oran Gafni, Yaniv Taigman as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
